description: The bar chart illustrates the popularity of different large language models (LLMs) and their associated datasets across three categories: Movies, Songs, and Basketball. The vertical axis represents popularity, scaled from 0 to 220, while the horizontal axis categorizes the data into the three topics. For each category, five distinct bars are shown, corresponding to LLMs and datasets: Llama3 (blue with diagonal stripes), Qwen2 (red with cross-hatch pattern), ChatGPT (yellow with diagonal stripes), Acc=0 & GT Ans (gray with horizontal stripes), and Acc=0 & Gene Ans (black with diagonal stripes). The chart reveals that popularity varies significantly by category and model. In the "Movies" category, all models show relatively low popularity, with Llama3 at approximately 25, Qwen2 at 30, ChatGPT at 35, and the two "Acc=0" datasets at around 15. In the "Songs" category, popularity increases, with Llama3 at about 60, Qwen2 at 65, ChatGPT at 70, and the "Acc=0" datasets at roughly 40. The "Basketball" category exhibits the highest popularity for all models, with Llama3 reaching approximately 170, Qwen2 at 190, ChatGPT at 175, and the "Acc=0" datasets at around 100. The data suggests that model popularity is strongly influenced by the topic, with "Basketball" being the most popular category overall.
